Open with one sentence I can say straight away.
Use “I”, not “we”, and name what I personally decided.
Give one number per example when I have one.
Keep behavioral answers to situation, action, result.
For technical questions, say the trade-off out loud before the detail.

demo.label: Example: a question and its suggested answer
demo.question: How would you design rate limiting for a public API?
demo.lead: I would put a token bucket per API key in front of the service, backed by Redis so every node sees the same counts.
demo.point1: Limits by key and by route, with burst headroom
demo.point2: 429 with Retry-After, so clients back off cleanly

from collections import Counter

def top_k_frequent(nums, k):
    counts = Counter(nums)
    return [n for n, _ in counts.most_common(k)]
